engine.title: Cache Compilation Engine
engine.balanced_desc: Balanced compression. Slightly slower import, but slightly smaller size on disk. (Recommended)
engine.high_desc: High compression. Highest space savings, but slowest rebuild speed. Especially not recommended on those with older machines or using Static Bundle.
engine.dynamic_cache_desc: Dynamic Cache: Builds separate caches per set. Faster rebuild times, hot-swappable configurations, and flexible set updates.
engine.none_desc: No compression. Fastest rebuild speed, but largest cache size on disk.
engine.static_bundle_desc: Static Bundle: Merges all active sets into a single bundle to maximize in-game loading performance. Any change requires a full rebuild.

walkthrough.title: Getting Started with PlumbobForge
walkthrough.welcome_sub: The high-performance custom content manager, cache builder, and mod organizer for The Sims 3.
walkthrough.feat_speed_desc: Combines packages into high-performance cache packages designed to drastically reduce game load times.
walkthrough.feat_sets_desc: Organize thousands of packages into structured folders with intuitive drag-and-drop, custom icons, and colors.
walkthrough.feat_profiles_desc: Create tailored configurations for different save files or gameplay themes, and switch between them with a single click.
walkthrough.library_desc: Your central workspace for organizing, inspecting, and managing custom content.
walkthrough.library_f1_desc: Group your CC into custom folders (e.g. Hair, Clothing, Build, Mods). Drag and drop packages between sets and customize set icons and colors.
walkthrough.library_f2_desc: Instantly filter packages by item type (CAS Parts, Objects, Sliders, Patterns, Mods), CAS categories, age/gender tags, or user tags.
walkthrough.library_f3_desc: Click any item to view high-resolution extracted 3D/catalog previews, detailed CAS flags, file sizes, and individually toggle items enabled or disabled.
walkthrough.configs_desc: Create modular loadout profiles so you only deploy the CC needed for each game session.
walkthrough.configs_f1_desc: Set up custom configurations for different saves or themes (e.g. 'Victorian Decade', 'Sci-Fi World', 'Default Modern', 'Lightweight Testing').
walkthrough.configs_f2_desc: Simply check or uncheck which Sets are active in each configuration. PlumbobForge will only build game caches for active sets.
walkthrough.configs_f3_desc: Switch your active configuration before starting The Sims 3 to load only relevant mods without ever having to manually move files around.
walkthrough.tools_desc: Dedicated utilities to keep your game fast, healthy, and organized.
walkthrough.tools_f1_desc: Build in-game Buy/Build collection packages with custom icons, and optionally hide collection objects from the general catalog to prevent clutter.
walkthrough.tools_f2_desc: Safely purge temporary script caches, world caches, and thumbnails cache to fix texture corruption and solve game crashes.
walkthrough.tools_f3_desc: Scan your Sims 3 directory for configuration issues, detect duplicate files, repair corrupted packages, and verify Sims3Pack integrity.
walkthrough.quick_settings_desc: Personalize your workspace and choose your caching preferences right now.
walkthrough.theme_mode_desc: Choose between dark, clean light mode, or follow your operating system appearance.
walkthrough.accent_color_desc: Customizes buttons, toggles, active tabs, and highlights across the entire app.
walkthrough.ready_desc: You're all set to begin using PlumbobForge.
walkthrough.migration_prompt_title: Migrating from CC Magic or s3mo?
walkthrough.migration_prompt_desc: If you have existing content in CC Magic or s3mo, import your sets, configurations, and packages automatically. You can also skip this and import anytime later in Settings.
walkthrough.get_started_hint: Click 'Get Started' below to enter PlumbobForge and start organizing.
